Class StagePosition

java.lang.Object
org.micromanager.StagePosition
public class StagePosition extends Object
Description of the position of a 1 or 2 axis stage.

  • Field Details

    • x

      @Deprecated public double x
      Deprecated.
      Use methods instead.
      For two-axis stages, the X position; for one-axis stages, the only stage position. For example, if using a Z focus drive, its position would be given by the "x" parameter.

    • y

      @Deprecated public double y
      Deprecated.
      Use methods instead.
      The Y position for two-axis stages.

    • z

      @Deprecated public double z
      Deprecated.
      RESERVED: do not use.

    • stageName

      @Deprecated public String stageName
      Deprecated.
      Use set1DPosition(String, double) or set2DPosition(String, double, double) to set; use getStageDeviceLabel() to access.
      The stage device label.

    • numAxes

      @Deprecated public int numAxes
      Deprecated.
      Use set1DPosition(String, double) or set2DPosition(String, double, double) to set; use getNumberOfStageAxes(), is1DStagePosition(), or is2DStagePosition() to access.
      The number of stage axes. Must be 1 or 2.
